Definition: to be (causatively, make) zealous, i.e. (in a bad sense) jealous or envious
BiblicalUsage: 1) to envy, be jealous, be envious, be zealous; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to be jealous of; 1a2) to be envious of; 1a3) to be zealous for; 1a4) to excite to jealous anger; 1b) (Hiphil) to provoke to jealous anger, cause jealousy
